# Hangzhou Chemnitz International Trade Co., Ltd. (Chemnitz)

> Project-based China-market vehicle sourcing and China-side export coordination for overseas automotive dealers, wholesale buyers, fleet operators, and commercial importers. Based in Hangzhou, Zhejiang, China (established October 10, 2023). Commercial orders start from 1 trial unit under EXW, FCA, or FOB China handover terms (Khorgos, Kashgar, Nansha, Ningbo, Shanghai, Tianjin, Qingdao).

Current redesigned website with equivalent public pages in English, Chinese, Spanish, French, Russian, and Arabic. Confirm selected trim, availability, export licensing pathway, contracting entity, export terms, and destination import requirements with the team per order. Manufacturer guide prices and public listings are for reference only — not a final export offer, live stock commitment, or destination import-eligibility guarantee.
